adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the new refresh flow does `if (response.statusText !== "OK") throw ...` after the token refresh `fetch(...)`. This is a brittle correctness check: a successful HTTP response can have an empty `statusText` (common in some fetch implementations / HTTP/2), causing an exception for valid responses. The diff shows this check was introduced alongside always performing a refresh-token request before returning the jsforce connection (done unconditionally in `getClient`).
